title: Rearrange Words In A Sentence
statement:
Reorder the words in `text` by increasing word length. When lengths tie, preserve their original order. Capitalize the first character of the result and make all other letters lowercase.

## Examples

```text
Input: text = "Keep calm and code on"
Output: "On and keep calm code"
```

```text
Input: text = "To be or not to be"
Output: "To be or to be not"
```

## Constraints

- `1 <= text.length <= 10^5`
- The sentence begins with an uppercase letter; remaining letters are lowercase.
- Words are separated by one space.
